title: co-creative platform: app configuration (platform.app.json)
description: Owned by the co-creative platform. Configuration the app owns: applied with the images by platform-deploy.yml. Components (web, job names) must exist in the platform definition (apps/<slug>/main.bicepparam); CPU, memory and replicas must stay within its ceilings.

minReplicas.description: 0 = scale to zero (default); 1 = always warm (costs money).

jobs.description: Keyed by job name (as in the platform definition).

replicaTimeout.description: Seconds before an execution is stopped.

cpu.description: vCPU; memory must be 2 GiB per vCPU.

env.description: Plain (non-secret) settings. Platform names (AZURE_CLIENT_ID, APP_SLUG, PLATFORM_*, ...) are reserved.
